name: DBT Junior Research Fellowship via Biotechnology Eligibility Test (DBT-JRF / BET)
funder: Department of Biotechnology (DBT), Government of India (exam by NTA)
amount: Rs 37,000/month JRF (2 years) then Rs 42,000/month SRF (3 years) + HRA + Rs 30,000/year contingency
other_rules: Category I awardees must register for PhD within 2 years
notes: 2026 cycle: applications 19 Mar to 9 Apr 2026, exam 17 May 2026; next cycle expected at the same time. Category II rank holders are eligible for project positions but get no DBT fellowship.
